title: Windows 20H2 nodes are no longer supported by the EBS CSI node plugin

detection.reason: a Windows node's OS build is not collected in a form the rule can read; osImage names the edition

quote: Windows 20H2 hosts are no longer supported.
remediation: Replace Windows 20H2 (build 19042) nodes with a supported Windows Server LTSC release before upgrading: the Windows node plugin image is no longer built for 20H2, so its pods there cannot pull.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -l kubernetes.io/os=windows -o json | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.metadata.name): \(.status.nodeInfo.osImage) \(.status.nodeInfo.kernelVersion)"'  # a kernelVersion of 10.0.19042.* is Windows 20H2
